overall_notes: The paper focuses on unsupervised text simplification using reinforcement learning with a comprehensive reward function. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization of model names and consolidation of metric variants. The paper uses both automatic metrics (SARI, BLEU, readability scores) and a well-designed human evaluation task measuring reading efficiency.
